summary.text: Borris Miles is a Democratic member of the Texas State Senate who has represented District 13 since 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He previously served in the Texas House of Representatives and works in the insurance business.

paragraphs.text: Borris Miles earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from Sam Houston State University.

His career includes work as a police officer for the Houston Independent School District Police Department and running the Borris L. Miles Insurance Agency, and he has been affiliated with the Urban League and the United Negro College Fund, according to Ballotpedia.
Miles represented District 146 in the Texas House of Representatives from 2007 to 2009 and from 2011 to 2013.

He assumed office in the State Senate in 2017, and in 2023-2024 he was assigned to the Criminal Justice, Health & Human Services, Natural Resources and Economic Development, Nominations and Transportation committees, along with the Committee of the Whole Senate.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026, in which he was the only candidate on the ballot.
